content: Insurance agent Neha Kapoor followed up with customer Aaradhya Verma regarding the health policy renewal (HL-001234) and provided a renewal form. Aaradhya acknowledged receipt, reviewed the form, and asked for clarification on the updated premium amount and pre-existing conditions coverage before proceeding with her signature.

action_items: Clarify changes in the premium amount
Clarify updated coverage for pre-existing conditions
Sign and return the renewal form
